_comment: F02_tunnels measured against the nine DoD dimensions AS WRITTEN (item 2 = enumerated; residuals = explicitly bounded), per engineering-specs/phase4-measurement-standard-ruling.md. Judgments authored; every fact derived from a pinned artifact at run time. Regenerate: tools/phase4_f02_written_bar_assessment.py

standard.item2_bar: enumerated, scoped to relevant (NOT empty unresolved set)
standard.vocabulary: bounded-exhausted remains a stop decision and never reads as met; this assessment publishes measurement, not disposition

authority.author_conflict: the assessor did not author F02's underlying evidence, but did author this assessment, the F01 exemplar it copies, and the F-row census whose durable_evidence result it carries forward -- so the standard being applied and the application of it share an author. Every state below is a submission to a fresh detached verifier, not a promotion; `partial` and `not_met` are as challengeable as a `met` would be

carried_forward.note: measured there against pinned bytes; re-deriving it here would be a second opinion on a settled measurement, not evidence

registry_disposition_for_contrast.note: the registry carries ONE blanket basis across all nine dimensions and scores the row 0/9. That is a disposition, not a measurement -- and it understates the row: durable_evidence is measured met and five other dimensions hold real, bounded evidence

fact_provenance.rule: facts are recorded through fact(key, value, source); a value cannot be stored without naming a pinned artifact, and every lookup is strict, so a renamed or removed key aborts the run instead of silently defaulting

facts.census_durable_reason: 4/4 declared fixtures intact -- external ones exist, are centrally pinned and byte-match; in-repo ones exist and are git-tracked
facts.census_triage_source_closure: no byte-matched source registered for this row
facts.row_declared_missing: Stage-2 objective / completion condition. (Hazard + overlay confirmation are done.)
facts.row_declared_fixture_need: A route that collects a pickup and fires a berry in Tunnels: the 0x02 and 0x08 pool gates never passed for ANY class in the traced run, so their negative for 0x5A rests on the decoded mask plus measured flags rather than a demonstrated pass (the 0x04 gate did pass 1054x, so the method detects passes).
facts.record_field_chain: a3=ctorType -> metaB[ctorType]; action_id=row+0x00 -> record+0x20; active_type=row+0x02 -> record+0x22; flags=row+0x10 -> record+0x33
facts.region_code3_consumer_branch: .L_800496E8: IDENTICAL body to code 2 via the shared tail .L_80049700 -- a SECOND exit-code value

durable_evidence.basis: CARRIED FORWARD, not re-derived: 4/4 in analysis/phase4_f_row_measured_census.json -- 4/4 declared fixtures intact -- external ones exist, are centrally pinned and byte-match; in-repo ones exist and are git-tracked. This assessment fails loudly if that measurement ever moves off 'met'

original_oracle.written_bar: behavior asserted against the ORIGINAL game's own natural execution, not injected state
original_oracle.basis: the debris negative is measured on natural execution of a pinned pristine-media movie (SCUS-94288, v4, 7460 frames) with no perturbation: 198373 gate examinations, 154856 of them on flags-0x20 records, 0 leaks, 0 unpairable passes, truncated=False; a POSITIVE CONTROL (1054 passes on one gate) shows the method detects a pass, and the spawner control fired 573 times on domain ['0x0000005a']
original_oracle.gap: no oracle at all for the row's declared missing item ('Stage-2 objective / completion condition. (Hazard + overlay confirmation are done.)'); no executable assertion artifact is registered for this row (the probe measures, it does not assert); and the anchor is a save state, not a cold boot (from_boot=False), so load/boot behaviour is outside the oracle's reach

complete_frontier.written_bar: item 2 AS WRITTEN: callers/callees/callbacks/indirect tables ENUMERATED, scoped to relevant -- not an empty unresolved set
complete_frontier.basis: for the debris half the frontier IS enumerated and its residual IS bounded: 11 resident sites referencing the pool base, 117 walker-dispatch entries, 129 metadata rows, 37 distinct live allocator callers over 7280 events, the spawner pinned uniquely to a FILE (OVL/LEVEL03_LEVEL.BIN, 4/4 callers matched, unique=True), and 5 residuals written up under '## Residual — enumerated and bounded' -- including the named limit that the consumer scan would still miss a pool reference reached through a stored pointer
complete_frontier.gap: this row names TWO subjects -- gates AND falling debris -- plus a declared missing objective/completion condition; the debris half carries essentially all of the row's own evidence. No frontier is enumerated for the gate machinery or the objective/completion path in THIS row; scoped to the debris half alone this would be a met-candidate, scoped to the row as named it is not

campaign_breadth.written_bar: conclusions generalize across every applicable stage, variant, lifecycle, and exceptional path -- which requires the applicable set itself to be enumerated
campaign_breadth.basis: every F02 artifact replays the SAME single route: 1 distinct movie across all of them, one level, one any% route. The pinned corpus holds 17 LEVEL02 movies and 20 LEVEL02 saves, of which the row declares 4 fixtures total; the 36397-frame 100% run (v4, pristine_serial, bytes match pin=True) has never been replayed by this row (replayed_by_this_row=False)
campaign_breadth.gap: the applicability universe is unenumerated in both directions: which stages instantiate this contact class (the experiment names a second call site in another level and did not replay it), and which routes / variants / exceptional paths within Tunnels are in scope. 'Every applicable' still has no denominator

typed_state.written_bar: state fields typed and value domains bounded (enumerating an untyped residual bounds the WORKLIST, not the STATE)
typed_state.basis: the contact record is typed field-by-field from the image and the chain is written down (a3=ctorType -> metaB[ctorType]; action_id=row+0x00 -> record+0x20; active_type=row+0x02 -> record+0x22; flags=row+0x10 -> record+0x33); 7 ctor types resolved statically against 129 metadata rows, and the live run bounds observed value domains for 27 ctor types across 322 pool samples
typed_state.gap: three flags bits have no located consumer, so their domain is measured but their meaning is inference; the render-attribute table's field semantics are self-declared inferred-not-proven in the decompilation header; and no state at all is typed for the gates or the objective/completion condition

lifecycle.written_bar: cold boot / load / first use / repeated use / exhaustion / retirement / reuse each evidenced
lifecycle.basis: allocation and repeated use are measured live (573 spawns, 7280 allocator events); reuse is measured as round-robin recycling (64/64 slots changed over 207 samples); the load/idle phase is captured from a save anchor (64 occupied slots, 0 records changing, pool RAM changed=False)
lifecycle.gap: no cold boot in the evidence base at all (from_boot=False); retirement (the distance cull) is a static decode that was never sampled live; exhaustion of the 64-slot pool was never provoked; no per-phase claim map is registered for this row the way F01 has one; and nothing covers the gates' or the objective's lifecycle

cross_system_behavior.written_bar: native combinations exercised (carry+damage, powers+jump, projectiles at transitions, enemies vs hazards/plants)
cross_system_behavior.basis: one native crossing is measured end-to-end and negatively: player traversal through a live debris field for the whole run, with health written 5 times from 3 PCs and none on a contact path; the pool is also crossed against the actor system with 1054 demonstrated passes for other classes
cross_system_behavior.gap: 2 of 3 pool gates never passed for ANY class in the traced run, so the pickup-collection and berry-projectile crossings were never exercised -- the row states this itself as its fixture need ('A route that collects a pickup and fires a berry in Tunnels: the 0x02 and 0x08 pool gates never passed for ANY class in the traced run, so their negative for 0x5A rests on the decoded mask plus measured flags rather than a demonstrated pass (the 0x04 gate did pass 1054x, so the method detects passes).'). No combination matrix exists for gates x grain x exit

original_interfaces.written_bar: interfaces documented; unknowns enumerated with named obstructions
original_interfaces.basis: the central allocator's ABI is documented and its argument domains are MEASURED per caller: 37 callers with recorded a0/a1/a3 domains over 3606 distinct call signatures; the metadata-row -> record field mapping is written down; the superseded predecessor artifact is explicitly marked (superseded_artifact_marked=True) rather than deleted, which is what the contract asks for superseded claims
original_interfaces.gap: the semantic half is unresolved with named obstructions (unconsumed flags bits; inferred-not-proven render-attribute fields), and the gate/objective interfaces in the stage overlay are undocumented in this row

source_closure.written_bar: byte-matched C through the original toolchain for the row's governing functions
source_closure.basis: measured, not assumed: 7 governing code addresses taken from this row's own artifacts resolve to 5 build units in the segments registry -- 0 matching C and 5 hand-written byte-exact ASM. 1 address is overlay code with no resident build unit, and its image (OVL/LEVEL03_LEVEL.BIN) has 0 matched functions out of 7 in the overlay census. The src_re file for the allocator self-declares documentation-grade pseudocode (True), so it is not the build unit and does not count. Census triage agrees: 'no byte-matched source registered for this row'
source_closure.gap: byte-exact reassembly is not the written bar; C through the original toolchain is. Nothing in this row is even attempted at the C level, and the stage's own overlay has no decompilation track entry. (For contrast, the function that would govern the row's EXIT path is byte-matched C -- 0x80038F38 sector_region_code_query (byte-matched C, src/main/80038f38_sector_region_code_query.c) -- but it belongs to E02/F01, not to this row's governing set.)

summary: 1 met, 0 met-candidate, 6 partial, 2 not met, 0 unmeasured -- against the WRITTEN bars. The row is honestly half-answered: the falling-debris half is closed to a reviewed structural negative with 5 enumerated residuals, the gates half and the declared objective/completion condition carry no evidence in this row, and no dimension reaches met except the one measured elsewhere.
notable: The row's evidence base is ONE route. 17 LEVEL02 movies are already pinned (9 E09 gate movies, 4 E10 hazard movies, plus a 36397-frame 100% Interpreter run); the row declares 4 fixtures and asks for a NEW recording. Whether the 100% run satisfies that need is UNMEASURED here (it needs a replay) -- but this row has been burned once before by assuming the corpus lacked a movie it already had.

3 F02 tools are credited as generator_references of the 100% movie in the central pin; 0 of them actually name that path. The credit appears to come from a basename collision with the any% run and should not be read as breadth coverage.

8 other baseline rows name this stage: A09_seed_pickup_drop, B09_super_jump, C04_enemy_token, E01_terrain_visual, E07_event_vm, E09_grain_gates, E13_hud_results, F06_birdnest -- and this row cites 2 artifact paths in total, none of them theirs. E09 binds the LEVEL02 grain-gate mechanism, which is this row's OWN first named subject ('gates'). Separately the pinned corpus holds 4 E10 LEVEL02 hazard movies (falling rocks and pits) that no F02 artifact touches. A verifier scoping this row should decide what belongs to F02 and what is already owned elsewhere before any of these dimensions is re-measured.

The row's declared missing item is the stage-2 objective/completion condition, and a cross-row artifact already bounds the exit half of it: the disc-side region-code census locates Tunnels' 589 authored sectors with histogram {'0': 579, '1': 9, '3': 1} -- exactly 1 exit-code sector (id [579]) and 9 instant-kill sectors, with 0 disc/runtime disagreements; the consumer binding gives that code's branch as: .L_800496E8: IDENTICAL body to code 2 via the shared tail .L_80049700 -- a SECOND exit-code value. This is EXIT, not OBJECTIVE -- it does not close the row's missing item, but the row does not record it at all.
